zh: 「聊天区动画效果」的「重绘」档换上插件自己的会话视图：它直接占据宿主「对话」视图的位置，标签条上不再多出一个标签，宿主转到「对话」的跳转同样落到它；档位离开「重绘」时宿主的「对话」原样回来。轮次进行中，新出现的一段思考把同一条链上此前的思考、正文与工具收成一行（思考×N · 输出×M · 工具×K），数字随内容跳变，用户插话重新开一条链，收拢走收缩、计数、停顿、展开四段时序；轮次成功结束后过程与中间叙述收起、只留最终回答与它的复制、分叉、反馈操作，失败、中断与等待批准的轮次保持展开，读者选中文字期间推迟折叠，历史轮次随时可以点开。思考在卡片里按阅读节奏滑动跟随，卡片只放思考的文字，读者滚回末尾即重新跟随；收进折叠的思考每段只占一行，写作「思考 · 内容」并带着思考卡片的边框，与中间输出一眼分开，按一下边框随全文展开；正文由宿主的 Markdown 渲染，新出现的词逐个淡入；工具行写出目标、改动行数与慢调用的计时，展开后是宿主自己的工具详情、输入与原始记录。轮次进行中的每一种状态（等待模型、思考、输出、准备与使用工具、等你操作）都由最新一条消息下面同一行说出；等待模型时这一行计时，过 10 秒标出「暂未响应」，进行中的过程也从这一行展开与收起。页面上装有 dsh-better-display 的阅读视图时这一份不登记；桌面端随带的 0.2.0 宿主与 npm 上的 0.2.1 宿主都能读。「动画」设为「减弱」时一律直接落位。
en: The Redraw tier of Chat-area animations swaps in the plugin's own conversation view: it takes the place of the host's Chat view itself, no extra tab appears in the strip, and whatever the host sends to Chat lands on it; leaving the Redraw tier brings the host's Chat back as it was. While a turn runs, a new thought folds the thinking, output and tools before it in the same chain into one row (Thinking×N · Output×M · Tools×K) whose figures roll as the work grows, a message from the reader starts a new chain, and each fold runs a shrink, count, pause, reveal sequence. Once a turn completes, its process and interim narration fold away and the final answer stays with its copy, branch and feedback actions; a failed, stopped or waiting turn stays open, a text selection holds the fold, and any past turn opens again. Thinking glides inside its card at reading pace, the card holds the thought's text alone, and scrolling it back to its end resumes the follow; a thought inside a fold takes one line, reading "Thinking · …" inside the thinking card's frame so it never passes for interim output, and a press grows the frame to its whole text; the answer is the host's own Markdown with each new word fading in; a tool row names its target, the lines it changed and how long a slow call has run, and opens onto the host's own tool view, its input and the raw record. Every live state of a running turn (waiting on the model, thinking, writing, preparing and using a tool, waiting for you) is said by one line under the newest message; while the model is silent the line times the wait and marks it "No response yet" past 10 seconds, and the running process opens and closes from it. With dsh-better-display's reading view on the page this one does not register; it reads both the 0.2.0 host the desktop ships and the 0.2.1 host on npm. With Animation set to Reduced everything lands at once.
